name: Harpy Jasmine
body:
HARPY JASMINE
CR 5

XP 1,600
N Medium plant
Init +0; Senses blindsense 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+8 natural)
hp 52 (7d8+21)
Fort +8, Ref +2, Will +3
Immune plant traits; Resist fire 5; Weakness vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed 5 ft., climb 5 ft.
Melee 2 slams +10 (1d4+5 B plus grab)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks haunting memory
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th, concentration +8)

At will—dancing lights, flare (DC 13), ghost sound (DC 13)
6/day—charm person (DC 14), lesser confusion (DC 14), wisp ally
3/day—hold person (DC 15), hypnotic pattern (DC 15)

STATISTICS

Str 20 (+5); Dex 10 (+0); Con 17 (+3); Int —; Wis 12 (+1); Cha 16 (+3)
Base Atk +5; CMB +10; CMD 20 (24 vs. bull rush or trip)
Skills Perception +9; Species Modifiers +8 Perception
SQ camouflage

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Camouflage (Ex)

Since a harpy jasmine looks like one of the ordinary plants of its native jungle when at rest, a DC 20 Perception check is required to notice it before it attacks for the first time. Anyone with ranks in Survival or Knowledge (nature) can use either of those skills instead of Perception to notice the plant.

Haunting Memory (Su)

Once per day as a full-round action, a harpy jasmine can create psychic echoes of people and events it has encountered, playing back moments of intense emotion or pain. This functions as a major image spell (CL 5th, Will DC 16), but the harpy jasmine can only replay events it has already experienced and has no conscious control over the images, sounds, and sensations it creates.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or warm forests
Organization solitary or thicket (2–5)
Treasure none

Harpy jasmine are carnivorous plants native to certain jungle planets—appearing as slow-moving vines with large, fragrant flowers. Although mindless, they instinctually tap into the psychic impressions of their victims, using those experiences to lure additional prey to their doom.
